[id="extensions-ai-prompt-usage"]
== Usage
The `ai-prompt` component registers Camel routes as prompts in a shared `AiPromptRegistry`.

To expose tagged prompt routes over MCP, add the `camel-quarkus-mcp-server` extension.
See xref:reference/extensions/mcp-server.adoc[MCP Server].
